Title: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
Category: AI Fundamentals
Source: Educational project notes

Artificial Intelligence is a branch of computer science that focuses on creating machines that can perform tasks requiring human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, decision-making, and understanding language. AI is used in virtual assistants, recommendation systems, healthcare, education, and transportation. Artificial Intelligence helps organizations automate tasks and improve efficiency.

title: AI Ethics and Data Privacy
retrieved_text:
Title: AI Ethics and Data Privacy
Category: AI Ethics
Source: Educational project notes

AI Ethics focuses on the responsible development and use of Artificial Intelligence. Important principles include fairness, transparency, accountability, and safety. Data privacy protects personal information from unauthorized access and misuse. AI developers should reduce bias, protect sensitive information, and ensure that AI systems are used responsibly. Ethical AI builds trust between technology and society.

Machine Learning is a subset of Artificial Intelligence that enables computers to learn from data without being explicitly programmed for every task. Machine learning improves its performance through experience and training data.

NLP makes interaction between humans and computers easier.
